notes:
1.2.6: reminders at the start time for tasks and routines

- Timed tasks now remind at their start time as well as the early reminder; a task added
  less than the early-reminder time ahead used to get no reminder at all
- Timed routines remind 10 min before, or at the start if that is already closer
- Early reminder can be set to None (start time only)
- Settings > Notifications lists the next reminders; schedule also refreshes after the
  8-second load fallback
